name: Canada
description: Follow Canada, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Fears of a Canadian trade war are overblown. So far, it’s more of a skirmish
changes.summary: Listening to most of the media and Canada ’s prime minister, you’d think the U.S. and its northern neighbor were in a full-blown trade war after new tariffs were announced days ago. changes.title: Bessent Claims Canada Is Too Small to Fight a Trade War With the U.S.
changes.summary: At gathering of G20 finance ministers, the Treasury secretary accused Canada’s prime minister of starting a “political shouting match” over U.S. trade policies.

changes.title: What Wildfire Smoke Reveals About How We Respond to Climate Risk
changes.summary: The sun rises behind the U.S. Capitol building as smoke from wildfires in Canada fills the air on July 17 in Washington D.C. —Kevin Carter—Getty Images A month ago, I was running embarrassingly late to a meeting in D.C. And so, even though I knew the air pollution outside from the Canadian wildfires was a hazard to my.

changes.title: Three days of Ontario wildfire smoke brought unhealthy air to 106 million person-days
changes.summary: Smoke from Canada's July wildfires exposed people across Canada and the United States to unhealthy, very unhealthy or hazardous air for nearly 106 million person-days between July 15–17. changes.title: Want to catch a glimpse of the solar eclipse from North America? Here's where and when
changes.summary: If you're far enough north in the U.S. and Canada, you might savor a partial eclipse as the moon nibbles away at the sun.

changes.title: At least 200 major wildfires burn across U.S. and Canada
changes.summary: Hot and dry conditions are fueling at least 200 major wildfires in the western U.S. and Canada. Meanwhile, images show the scale of destruction in Spokane, Washington, from the fires there last week. Ian Lee reports.

changes.title: Thousands evacuated as wildfires burn across western U.S. and Canada
changes.summary: Wildfires are burning across the western U.S. and Canada, leaving some residents keeping a wary eye out for possible evacuation orders.

changes.title: Wildfires in western Canada force more than 20,000 people to evacuate
changes.summary: The Royal Canadian Mounted Police said an 80-year-old woman died while trying to escape a wildfire that forced evacuations in the Okanagan Lake region.

changes.title: Fires grip western U.S., British Columbia: "It doesn't seem like it's real"
changes.summary: Nearly 100 large wildfires strained firefighting resources around the U.S. this weekend. The fire danger also exploded in Canada amid hot and dry conditions. Gwen Baumgardner reports, and Andrew Kozak has the forecast.

changes.title: Crews battle wildfires in western U.S. and Canada
changes.summary: There have been 183 new wildfires, including eight large ones, across the U.S. since Saturday, the National Interagency Fire Center reported on Sunday. (Image credit: U.S. Forest Service/Fishlake National Forest).
